1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device __comprises a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium, and wherein the alignment device performs a functional transformation of the demonstrated user actions into aligned step identifications that control a display device to present the documented procedure in a manner responsive to the user's demonstrated actions__.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, __and wherein the identification of the current step causes a functional change in the display of the documented procedure on a user interface__.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change in the visual presentation of the user interface__.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, __wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change in the visual presentation of the user interface that is dependent upon the computed alignment__.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, __and wherein the identification of the next step causes a functional change in the display of the documented procedure on a user interface__.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change in the visual presentation of the user interface__.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, __wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change in the visual presentation of the user interface that is dependent upon the computed alignment__.

9. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on __a comparison of specific action sequences and interaction patterns extracted from the user interface and the documented procedure, wherein the comparison produces a quantified measure that controls subsequent display operations__.

10. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment, __wherein the captured images are processed by the processor to extract action features that are compared against documented procedure features__.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the previous user experiences are stored in a database and retrieved to inform the alignment computation in a manner that affects the functional output of the apparatus__.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, __wherein the document action extractor comprises a processor executing instructions that parse the documented procedure and identify step boundaries__.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the alignment device comprises a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium__; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, __wherein the highlighting device and scrolling device perform functional transformations of the user interface display that are dependent upon the computed alignment__.

14. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising a camera, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for capturing images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions, and wherein said alignment device uses at least some of the captured images to calculate the alignment, __wherein the captured images are processed by the processor to extract action features that inform the alignment computation__.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the previous user experiences are stored in a database and retrieved to inform the alignment computation in a manner that affects the functional output of the apparatus__.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the computing step is performed by a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium, and wherein the computed alignment is used to control a functional change in a display device__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, __wherein the identification causes a functional change in the display of the documented procedure__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change in the visual presentation of the user interface__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, __wherein the identification causes a functional change in the display of the documented procedure__.

21. (Currently amended) The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, __wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change in the visual presentation of the user interface__.

22. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the at least one similarity metric is based on __a comparison of specific action sequences and interaction patterns extracted from the demonstrated user actions and the documented procedure, wherein the comparison produces a quantified measure that controls subsequent display operations__.

25. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the previous user experiences are stored in a database and retrieved to inform the alignment computation__.

26. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure, __wherein the extracting step comprises parsing the documented procedure and identifying step boundaries__.

27. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions as recited in claim 17, __wherein the program instructions, when executed by a processor, cause the processor to perform functional transformations that result in control signals sent to a display device to alter the visual presentation of the documented procedure in response to the demonstrated user actions__.

28. (Currently amended) A method for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the method comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, __wherein the computing step is performed by a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium__; visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the computed alignment, __wherein the highlighting constitutes a functional change in the visual presentation of the user interface__; and automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the computed alignment, __wherein the scrolling constitutes a functional change in the display of the user interface__.

29. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment based on images of at least some of the demonstrated user actions captured by an imaging device, __wherein the captured images are processed to extract action features that inform the alignment computation__.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 28, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, __wherein the previous user experiences are stored in a database and retrieved to inform the alignment computation__.

32. (Currently amended) A program storage device readable by machine, tangibly embodying a program of instructions executable by the machine to perform method steps for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface as recited in claim 28, __wherein the program instructions, when executed by a processor, cause the processor to perform functional transformations that result in control signals sent to a display device to alter the visual presentation of the documented procedure in response to the demonstrated user actions__.
